comments.author: vertumnal
comments.body:
Some NaN losses while using PyG's GCN layer led me to discover that it doesn't work with negative edge weights. This made me think something similar could be happening with Graclus and — yep! The issue is resolved here by calling ```edge_attr = edge_attr.abs()``` before doing the forward pass.

It would be nice to have a validity check or short warning for the GCN and Graclus.
